title: TRINEXIS: An Alert-Aware Narration Policy and a Protocol for Measuring Its Effect on Alert Delivery
description: Unreleased working-tree revision of the TRINEXIS software and standalone technical report. The paper defines an alert-aware narration policy, real-log instrumentation, experiment protocols, blank NO DATA result templates, mocked Flask route tests, CI, and language-fallback documentation. No empirical detection, latency, distance-calibration, translation-rating, or user-study result is claimed.
